t: 阿斯图里亚王后阿多辛达被囚禁在一所修道院,以阻止外甥从毛雷加图斯手中夺回王位.
te: The Asturian queen Adosinda is held at a monastery to prevent her nephew from retaking the throne from Mauregatus.
